div.div:
On every host, per model × number format (scripts synced from s3://…/artifacts/host/ at boot):
1. stage_model.sh — pinned weights from the S3 cache, else from Hugging Face (sha256-checked), then cached
2. OpenVINO formats only: export container (optimum-intel / OVMS export_model.py) → IR, cached under models/ov/
3. serve.sh — docker run of the engine image with the cell's options; health check; one real request
4. Lambdas drive the load over HTTP inside the VPC; perf counters prove AMX use; raw records → S3
